heading: Presley Gerber dies at 27: A look at Cindy Crawford’s son’s career, DUI arrest and ‘misunderstood’ tattoo
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: Presley Gerber, the only son of Cindy Crawford and Rande Gerber, has died aged 27 at a rehabilitation facility. The model had spoken publicly about mental health, addiction and recovery in recent years.
